title: Jubilant Uruguayan Onion Bowl
description: A hearty bowl filled with caramelized onions and seasoned with jubilant spices, inspired by the flavors of Uruguay.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the sliced onion for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until caramelized.
Add the jubilant seasoning blend, red bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the onion mixture in bowls and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
